programme.title: Experiências.PT T1 - Ep. 19
programme.desc: Experiências.pt leva-o à descoberta de um Portugal autêntico e fascinante. João Kopke, surfista, músico e viajante, convida-o a partir em busca das melhores experiências para viver no país, procurando a raiz, a essência dos lugares e das suas gentes.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T1 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Há quem lhe chame a rainha do polvo ou a mestre do arroz. Neste episódio, Marlene Vieira vai provar que ambos os títulos lhe servem na perfeição. Arroz de bivalves à Bulhão Pato e Polvo Assado com Gnocchi e Pimento Padron. Parece-lhe bem?.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T1 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Da horta chegam-nos ingredientes frescos para uma ementa que agrada a todas as dietas. Neste episódio, Marlene Vieira vai servir uma entrada de Beterraba, requeijão e pinhões e ainda Trouxa de acelga recheada com legumes, cogumelos e feijão preto.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T1 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Em 2018, Marlene Vieira lançou um livro de Doces e neste episódio promete partilhar sugestões de sobremesas que te vão fazer querer comer e chorar por mais! Ah! E sem culpa… que estas não são light mas são na proporção certa!.

programme.title: Cozinha De Chef T1 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Neste episódio, Marlene Vieira traz duas receitas que nasceram no seu restaurante ZunZum e prometem conquistar muitas casas portuguesas: Bochechas de porco com batata doce e picadinho algarvio e Costeleta de sardinha panada com arroz de tomate.

programme.title: Cozinhamos Contigo T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje, a chef Lúcia Ribeiro, irá preparar a receita de “Sopa do Rio com peixe do mar e hortelã” proposta pelo Mercado de Santana de Caldas da Rainha e, depois, irá cozinhar “Lombinhos de porco preto assados”, uma receita que nos chega do Mercado de Alvalade em Lisboa.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Em várias regiões de França, novos proprietários de elegantes, mas muitas vezes degradados, castelos e palácios, lançam-se na aventura de os restaurar e transformar em lares de sonho e negócios sustentáveis.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Em várias regiões de França, novos proprietários de elegantes, mas muitas vezes degradados, castelos e palácios, lançam-se na aventura de os restaurar e transformar em lares de sonho e negócios sustentáveis.

programme.title: Eco Reset - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Nas Hiide Cabins, Vera Kolodzig e Raminhos exploram um conceito de alojamento pensado para desacelerar, rodeado pela tranquilidade da natureza. Uma viagem ao Ribatejo para sair da rotina com humor, boa disposição e muitas gargalhadas.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T5 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Scott e Debra voltam a encontrar-se com antigos clientes para os ajudar a transformar uma garagem nunca usada numa fantástica casa de campo com dois quartos.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T5 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Scott serve de mentor a dois jovens irmãos ambiciosos que querem aprender a transformar uma antiga casa rústica situada num rancho com bisontes numa casa de férias bem-sucedida.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece a família Chretien que procura o cachorrinho ideal para criar uma ligação com o seu filho tímido, o Julian. Visitam o cockapoo, o labradoodle e o shichon. Cada membro da família tem o seu preferido, mas o Julian surpreende os seus pais com a sua decisão.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Beverley Mahood conhece Inji, uma mãe solteira que procura um cachorrinho para realizar o sonho da sua filha Yasmine. Visitam o Yorkshire terrier, o papillon e o bichon maltês, mas quando Yasmine gosta de todos, a decisão de Inji torna-se difícil.

programme.title: Aqui Há Mão T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: No episódio dedicado à encadernação, exploramos, sob o olhar de Fátima Lopes, esta arte tão antiga. Carlos Guerreiro, um dos últimos mestres deste ofício, é encadernador, restaurador e dourador e mantém viva a tradição através de técnicas antigas que inspiram a nova geração, como é o caso de Letícia Burkardt.

programme.title: The Dog Academy T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Milo “relâmpago”, um cruzado de labrador, está a deixar a tutora, Melissa, de bofes na boca. Sempre que ela o chama, ele sai a disparado; velocista canino é demasiado intenso para ela conseguir controlar.

programme.title: Ó Da Casa T2 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Estão convocados todos os pais, mães, tios e avós que queiram entrar nesta brincadeira! Neste episódio do Ó da Casa, vamos fazer brinquedos de madeira. Porquê? Porque são mais ecológicos, mais duradouros e são feitos com amor. Vamos a isso?.

programme.title: The Point With Liu Xin
programme.desc: The Point with LIU Xin is a current affairs program on CGTN. The program comments on global news through LIU Xin's very own unique perspective.

programme.title: As Pequenas Coisas
programme.desc: Em Los Angeles, no início dos anos 90, dois detetives investigam uma série de crimes violentos, num processo complexo que os leva até um estranho solitário que poderá ser o assassino.

programme.title: Underworld - O Submundo
programme.desc: Numa guerra que dura há séculos, os vampiros e lobisomens lutam pela supremacia do Submundo longe do olhar dos humanos. Mas agora os lobisomens planeiam raptar um jovem médico humano para criar uma nova e invencível espécie. Apenas Selene, uma guerreira vampira, pode impedir este plano.

programme.title: Ratazana Assassina
programme.desc: Brody é um ranger que se prepara para abrir um novo parque de campismo, com a ajuda dos sobrinhos. Tudo parece estar em ordem até que uma ratazana gigante, que sofreu uma mutação devido aos resíduos tóxicos, começar a matar tudo o que lhe aparece à frente.

programme.title: Um Traidor Dos Nossos
programme.desc: Um casal de férias em Marraquexe vê-se envolvido nos planos de um oligarca russo para desertar para o ocidente. Entre a mafia russa e os serviços secretos britânicos, o casal é obrigado a fazer uma perigosa viagem por Paris, Berna e pelos cantos mais obscuros da cidade de Londres.

programme.title: O Livro Das Soluções
programme.desc: Marc é um realizador de cinema que leva toda a sua equipa de produção para a pequena aldeia de Cévennes, onde a sua a criatividade gera milhões de ideias que o mergulham no caos total, o que o leva a escrever um guia de conselhos práticos, ‘O Livro das Soluções’…

programme.title: Funcionário Do Mês
programme.desc: Vincent Peltier é um funcionário público que é encorajado a apresentar a demissão quando a tutela começa a impor cortes. Para manter as benesses e evitar tal destino, aceita ser transferido para um dos piores e mais recônditos lugares do mundo, a Gronelândia…

programme.title: Despedida De Casado
programme.desc: Um recém-divorciado tenta superar o trauma da separação através de uma enorme festa de “despedida de casado”.

programme.title: Zona Proibida
programme.desc: John Wall é uma alma perdida que vagueia pela cidade de Nova Iorque e que acaba por ter uma ligação especial com duas jovens com quem passa o aniversário, refletindo sobre os percursos pelos quais as suas vida autodestrutivas os levaram.

programme.title: A Partida
programme.desc: Ben e a sua melhor amiga Tanner resolvem pregar uma partida à professora de Física que ameaça reprová-los, acusando-a falsamente nas redes sociais do homicídio de um estudante.

programme.title: Serenidade
programme.desc: O passado misterioso do comandante de um navio de pesca regressa para o assombrar quando a sua ex-mulher insiste em abordá-lo com um desesperado pedido de ajuda, enredando a sua vida numa nova dimensão em que nada é o que parece.

programme.title: After Depois Da Verdade
programme.desc: Hardin Scott e Tessa Young estão agora separados. Enquanto Hardin ganha hábitos pouco saudáveis, Tessa consegue o estágio dos seus sonhos, onde chama a atenção do seu novo colega, Trevor, inteligente e responsável… No entanto, Tessa não consegue esquecer Hardin, que é, afinal, o amor da sua vida.

programme.title: 21 Pontes
programme.desc: Andre Davis é um detetive da polícia de Nova Iorque que tem de capturar os responsáveis pelas mortes de vários colegas, numa operação-limite onde são fechadas as 21 pontes de Manhattan para impedir a fuga dos assassinos da ilha.

programme.title: Caçadores De Recompensa
programme.desc: Um famoso caçador de recompensas reencontra o seu principal inimigo, um fora-da-lei e um jogador profissional que ele tinha enviado para a prisão anos antes.

programme.title: Ben-Hur
programme.desc: Judah Ben-Hur é um nobre judeu, cuja heroica odisseia inclui ser escravizado pelos romanos, fugir de um barco de escravos durante uma batalha, vingar-se contra os seus carrascos durante uma violenta corrida de quadrigas numa arena e ainda um fatídico encontro com Jesus Cristo.

programme.title: Sucker Punch - Mundo Surreal
programme.desc: Uma jovem é internada num hospício contra a sua vontade. Como estratégia para lidar com tudo, ela recua para uma extravagante realidade alternativa onde se junta a quatro prisioneiras que se tornam guerreiras experientes com a missão de recolher os quatro itens que lhes permitam fugir.

programme.title: Os Ingleses Estão A Chegar
programme.desc: Harriet e Peter Fox são um casal de vigaristas ingleses que, após perderem uma grande soma ao póquer e ficarem a dever dinheiro a uma gangster psicótica, fogem para Los Angeles onde acabam por criar um elaborado plano para roubar um anel à rica ex-mulher de Peter.

programme.title: Countdown (2019)
programme.desc: Uma jovem enfermeira descarrega uma aplicação que consegue prever a data da morte de cada pessoa. A ela só lhe restam três dias de vida… O destino está traçado e o relógio não para de contar. Ela tem de encontrar uma maneira de se salvar ou então… vai morrer a tentar!

programme.title: Uma Boa Menina Como Tu
programme.desc: Depois de ser acusada pelo ex-namorado de não ter qualquer interesse em sexo, uma violinista cria uma arrojada lista de tarefas para conseguir ultrapassar os seus problemas com a intimidade.

programme.title: 13 Minutos
programme.desc: Quatro famílias numa cidade do centro dos EUA são testadas num único dia, quando um tornado devastador atinge a localidade. Quando a sirene toca, a comunidade tem apenas 13 minutos para chegar aos abrigos. Caminhos irão cruzar-se, vidas serão irreversivelmente alteradas, e a cidade será arrasada…

programme.title: True Justice: Travessia Mortífera
programme.desc: Quando um grupo de violentos traficantes de heroína invade as ruas de Seattle, Elijah Kane é chamado a liderar um esquadrão de polícias à paisana, que não vão olhar a meios para pôr um fim ao negócio de droga.

programme.title: True Justice: Condutas Perigosas
programme.desc: A equipa de Elijah Kane tem como missão deter um misterioso assassino de strippers, associado a rituais obscuross, antes deste voltar a cometer mais um crime.

programme.title: Justiça Singular
programme.desc: Casi é um idealista advogado público de Nova Iorque, prejudicado pelo sistema e quase a ser expulso da Ordem, que decide participar no roubo de um negócio de droga de 75 milhões de dólares.

programme.title: Flag Day: Dias Perdidos
programme.desc: Jennifer Vogel tenta superar os destroços do passado ao mesmo tempo que concilia o laço inescapável com o seu pai, que vive uma vida dupla de falsificador, assaltante de bancos e vigarista para a conseguir sustentar.

programme.title: Sempre A Abrir
programme.desc: Para ajudar a namorada a ir a uma entrevista de emprego em Los Angeles, o ex-motorista de fugas Charlie Bronson quebra a regra de isolamento a que está imposto pelo Plano de Proteção de Testemunhas mas é implacavelmente perseguido estrada fora pelo FBI e pelo seu ex-gangue.

programme.title: Cidade Sob Ameaça
programme.desc: Após ter provocado acidentalmente um grave acidente ao seu parceiro, o agente Jim Dillon jura nunca mais pegar numa arma, até ao dia em que um grupo de violentos motards invade a cidade onde ele é marshall e não lhe resta outra opção senão confrontar os fantasmas do seu passado para a defender.

programme.title: Gone - 12 Horas Para Viver
programme.desc: Jill Parrish está convencida que Molly, a sua irmã desaparecida, foi sequestrada pelo mesmo assassino em série de quem escapou no ano anterior. Mas será que Jill se encontra psicologicamente perturbada ou é a única que conhece a verdade, conseguindo encontrar Molly antes que seja tarde demais?

programme.title: Os Estagiários
programme.desc: Billy e Nick são vendedores cujas carreiras foram destruídas pela era digital. Na tentativa de provar que não estão obsoletos, conseguem um cobiçado estágio na Google, juntamente com um batalhão de pequenos génios. O problema é que eles são quase info-excluídos…

programme.title: O Hóspede
programme.desc: David é um soldado que se apresenta à família Peterson como amigo próximo do seu filho, que morreu em combate. Só que após acolher o jovem em casa, o casal começa a aperceber-se que há uma série de mortes que começam a assombrar a cidade, e que parecem estar todas ligadas à sua presença.

programme.title: As Pequenas Coisas
programme.desc: Em Los Angeles, no início dos anos 90, dois detetives investigam uma série de crimes violentos, num processo complexo que os leva até um estranho solitário que poderá ser o assassino.

programme.title: Domino - A Hora Da Vingança
programme.desc: Um polícia de Copenhaga procura fazer justiça pela morte de um colega que foi assassinado por um homem misterioso.

programme.title: Handel - The Triumph of Time and Truth
programme.desc: Emmanuelle Haim conducts Le Concert d’Astrée in a rendition of G. F. Handel’s two-part oratorio “Il Trionfo del Tempo e del Disinganno” (The Triumph of Time and Truth). The work with a libretto by Benedetto Pamphili was first performed in Rome, in 1707. Director Krzysztof Warlikowski has taken Handel’s first oratorio, written when the composer was only 22 years old, on in a deep, tender staging.

programme.title: Abbado conducts Mahler and Schönberg
programme.desc: The program is introduced with a short documentation about Schönberg's Pelleas et Melisande, based on a text by Claudio Abbado. Every musical theme relates to a special colour appearing on screen. What has been so remarkable about Abbado’s Mahler performances is that their impact has never been achieved at the expense of the multiple sensitivities, subtleties and extreme sophistication.

programme.title: The 12 Cellists - Documentary
programme.desc: Directed in 2012 by Enrique Sánchez Lansch, the documentary The 12 Cellists follows the 12 cellists of the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra. Since 1972, this group is a staple of the international musical universe. Whether they play classical music, jazz, tango or avant-garde music, these talented musicians invariably enthrall audiences with the wide range of unique and bewitching sounds they produce with their cellos.

programme.title: Elgar - Concerto for Cello, Op. 85
programme.desc: For over two decades, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its creation on May 1 with the annual Europakonzert, which in 2010 was held in Oxford. Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra and the young American cellist Alisa Weilerstein, who has attracted widespread attention for her passionate yet precise musicianship, perform a breathtaking rendition of Edward Elgar’s Cello Concerto, Op. 85.

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: German Brass goes Bach
programme.desc: The German Brass ensemble delivers some of Bach's most popular tunes in breathtaking brass arrangements. Recorded live from the magnificent St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, this concert features timeless pieces by the legendary German composer, such as Toccata and Fugue in D minor, Adagio in G minor, and Jesus bleibet meine Freude.

programme.title: Mendelssohn - Violin Concerto, Op. 64
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in the 2016 edition of the Europakonzert. This time, it takes place at the beautiful Baroque church of Røros, a Norwegian mining town whose intact picturesque old town makes it a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The talented Norwegian violinist Vilde Frang is the star soloist in Mendelssohn’s songful Violin Concerto, Op. 64, which she plays with warmth, elegance and effortless virtuosity.

programme.title: Works by Beethoven and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: In May and June 2021, Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrated her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France. In this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians who are particularly close to her heart: cellist Mischa Maisky, violinist Maxim Vengerov, and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï.

programme.title: Grieg - String Quartet in G minor, Op. 27
programme.desc: String quartet Cuarteto Mendelssohn de BP, in its 2018 configuration of violinists Olga Artyugina and Eva Rabchevska, violist Bella Chic and cellist Hayk Sukiasyan, performs Edvard Grieg’s String Quartet in G minor, Op. 27. Completed in 1878, it is the composer’s second attempt in the genre. His first string quartet, written in the early 1860s, was lost, and the third one was left incomplete at the composer’s death.

programme.title: Music of Naples
programme.desc: Throughout the centuries, the Italian city of Naples has proved to have a remarkably favorable climate for artistic innovation. The presence of the royal or vice royal courts, the practice of music in churches, fraternities, and charitable institutions, financial support from well-to-do citizens, and the popularity of song and dance in public life made for an extraordinarily diverse musical landscape.

programme.title: PIAM - Semi-final: Mendelssohn and Chopin
programme.desc: Acclaimed classical music talent scout Antonio Mormone (1930-2017) lives on as the name-giver of the Premio Internazionale Antonio Mormone (PIAM), awarded to the winner of the Italian music competition of the same name. The first edition of this competition, which was held in various venues in Milan from 2019 to 2021, was dedicated to the piano.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Mexican Concert - Part II
programme.desc: Raúl Delgado conducts the Orquesta Sinfonica de Minería in a concert program dedicated to Mexican composers. This program, which includes the second part of the concert, features the following works: Blas Galindo's 'Sones de Mariachi', Arturo Marquez's Danzón No. 2, José Pablo Moncayo's 'Huapango', and Genero Codina's 'March of Zacatecas'. This concert was recorded at the Academia de Música del Palacio de Minería in Mexico City in 2019.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Violin Concerto No. 1, Op. 77
programme.desc: In May 2019, the new principal conductor of the Gewandhaus, Andris Nelsons, presented Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 5 with his orchestra in combination with Shostakovich’s Violin Concerto No. 1 with outstanding violinist Baiba Skride as the soloist.

programme.title: Rina Sala Gallo Piano Competition 2022 - Finalists
programme.desc: The Rina Sala Gallo International Piano Competition takes place every two years in the Italian city of Monza. Founded in 1947 by Monza-born pianist Rina Sala Gallo and Brescia-born pianist Arturo Benedetti Michelangeli, the competition is one of Monza’s most prestigious cultural events today.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concertos No. 14 And No. 23
programme.desc: Regarded as one of the finest interpreters of Romantic repertoire, Francesco Attesti (*1975) gave his first recital at age 11 and by the time he was 23, had earned the highest honours in piano from Florence’s Conservatorio Luigi Cherubini. In this recording of his 2016 Deeply Mozart concert tour, Attesti performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s piano concertos KV 449 and KV 488 with the Italian OIDA Orchestra and conductor Paolo Belloli.

programme.title: Naples, City of Keyboards - Ascanio Mayone
programme.desc: ‘In compositions including passagework, out-of-tune notes which are not in accordance with the laws of counterpoint do indeed occasionally occur. But without them, a beautiful effect is not possible!’ Neapolitan Ascanio Mayone resolutely consigns criticism of his daring compositional style to the wastepaper basket. He has found the perfect ambassador in Louise Acabo: the impressive and very young winner of the Concours Corneille 2018.

programme.title: J. S. Bach - Arias, solos, and duets
programme.desc: Baritone Matthias Goerne teams up with violinist Vilde Frang, cellist Nicolas Altstaedt, flutist Stathis Karapanos, and harpsichordist Michaela Hasselt in this program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. They perform baritone arias from Bach’s most beautiful cantatas, as well as solo pieces and duets. On the program are Sonata No.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Bruckner's Symphony No. 7. The work occupies a singularly important place in the composer's output. It was with this piece that Bruckner finally achieved widespread recognition and it has remained one of his most popular works. The symphony adheres to the classical four-movement format.

programme.title: Riccardo Chailly conducts Mendelssohn
programme.desc: Riccardo Chailly’s inaugural concert as Kapellmeister of the Leipzig Gewandhaus Orchestra captures the full atmosphere of a unique musical occasion. The concert centers round composer Felix Mendelssohn, who founded the Gewandhaus Orchestra in 1743. It includes an overwhelming performance of Mendelssohn’s Symphony No.

programme.title: Brahms - Violin Sonata No. 3, Op. 108
programme.desc: In this splendid 2013 concert from the Church of Verbier, Switzerland, Greek violinist Leonidas Kavakos and Chinese pianist Yuja Wang join forces to interpret three sonatas by Johannes Brahms. Leonidas Kavakos rose to fame in 1985, when he became the youngest musician to ever win the first price of the prestigious Sibelius Competition.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Esa-Pekka Salonen
programme.desc: The Finnish composer and conductor Esa-Pekka Salonen (1958) was Music Director of the Los Angeles Philharmonic from 1992 until 2009. Under his dynamic leadership, it was recognized as one of the world's most outstanding orchestras. The exciting musical partnership Salonen established with his musicians was widely acclaimed in the international press.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: Jean Paul’s novel ‘Titan’, in which an artistically gifted young man, driven by his failure to find his way in society, eventually commits suicide in despair, inspired Gustav Mahler to compose his Symphony No. 1. The work did not come easily to Mahler: he composed it between 1887 and 1888 when he, in his twenties, was working as a conductor at the Oper Leipzig.

programme.title: Les Bains Macabres
programme.desc: French composer Guillaume Connesson (*1970) is building an impressive musical oeuvre, to which he has recently added an opera: 'Les bains macabres'. For this romantic contemporary thriller opera he worked closely with librettist Olivier Bleys (*1970), a successful French author with dozens of novels to his credit.

programme.title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents.

programme.title: Ravel - Sonata for violin and piano in G major
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform Maurice Ravel’s Sonata for violin and piano (No. 2) in G major, M. 77. The sonata consists of three movements. The piece is often listed as “No. 2”, yet the composer wrote his actual second sonata, which remained unpublished until 38 years after his death, before this one. This performance was recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan.

programme.title: Mariken in the Garden of Earthly Delights
programme.desc: The opera ‘Mariken in the Garden of Earthly Delights,’ to music by Calliope Tsoupaki, is based on the miracle play 'Mariken van Nieumeghen' (c. 1515). Over five centuries, this old story hasn’t lost a bit of its power and is unquestionably part of the canon of Dutch culture. In this opera, we follow the curious but vulnerable Mariken on a journey through a dark world.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink leads the Berliner Philharmoniker in the Seventh Symphony by Gustav Mahler, recorded at The Berliner Filharmonie in 1993. This symphony for a big orchestra premiered in 1908 in Prague under Mahler himself. In a few weeks, the composition was already performed in the Netherlands and Germany, but the audience did not immediately love it.

programme.title: Behind the Scenes at the Zurich Opera House
programme.desc: The Zurich Opera House is one of the most renowned in Europe. Fifteen premieres are staged here every year - a significant achievement, when one considers just how much work goes into each individual production.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. Beethoven wrote the work upon completion of his Symphony No. 5. Both symphonies premiered at the same legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No.

programme.title: Schumann - Humoreske, Op. 20
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op. 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece’s title refers to humor as an emotional state.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 38, K. 504
programme.desc: Gerd Albrecht conducts the Deutsche Kammerphilharmonie in a performance of W. A. Mozart’s “Prague” Symphony No. 38 (K. 504). The work was composed by Mozart in late 1786 and premiered in January 1787, during the composer’s first visit to Prague, hence the nickname “Prague”.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Romeo And Juliet - Fantasy Ouverture
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink starts with Tchaikovsky's Fantasy Overture from 'Roméo et Juliette'. The second piece by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is his famous Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major K.

programme.title: House of Dreams
programme.desc: House of Dreams is an imaginative concert designed by Alison Mackay. The concert is a magical journey to the meeting places of baroque art and music - five European homes where exquisite works by Bach, Handel, Vivaldi, Purcell and Marais were played against a backdrop of paintings by Vermeer, Canaletto, and Watteau. Stage direction by Marshall Pynkoski and narrated by Blair Williams.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff And Dvorák Trios
programme.desc: The Valerius Ensemble, consisting of Eeva Koskinen (violin), René Geesing (cello) and Ingo Lulofs (piano) plays Rachmaninoff’s Trio élégiaque Nr. 1 and the Finale of Dvorák’s Piano Trio No.3, Op. 65. Rachmaninoff composed this Trio in 1892 at the age of 19. The work does not have an opus number and consists only of one movement, which is highly unusual for a Piano Trio.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff - Piano Concerto No. 4, Op. 40
programme.desc: Fabio Luisi conducts the Danish National Symphony Orchestra in this powerful performance taken from the 150th Anniversary celebrations of Denmark’s national composer, Carl Nielsen. Alongside Nielsen’s inscrutably ironic Symphony No. 6, this performance features world-renowned French pianist Lise de la Salle as soloist in Rachmaninov’s Piano Concerto No. 4.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: Anton Bruckner's Symphony No. 9 can be seen as a farewell to life. Even as Bruckner began working on it in 1887, his health had begun to fail. He expressed the hope that 'God will grant me enough time to complete it,' and worked on it assiduously over the next years. But by late 1894 he had completed only the first three movements. When he died on 11 October 1896, he left six different versions of the finale, all of them incomplete.

programme.title: Mosaïque Project - Canadian Piano Quartets
programme.desc: This very special concert event celebrates the diversity and richness of Canada through the eyes and ears of its people. Ensemble Made in Canada’s Mosaique Project features a commissioned suite of piano quartets by 14 Canadian composers, each inspired by a region of our vast country. Their album release and two-year National tour culminate in St. Catharines’ stunning Partridge Hall!

programme.title: My heart is burning
programme.desc: René Pape perfectly embodies the new generation of opera singers: with a current and relaxed appearance, he craves new challenges and demonstrates an openness to ambitious experimentation. In the musical film My Heart Is Burning, René Pape sings and plays various roles that showcase the impressive versatility of his voice and the many facets of his personality. Directed by Sibylle Muth.

programme.title: Schubert - String Quartet No. 15 in G major
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents.

programme.title: Schumann - Cello Concerto in A minor, Op. 129
programme.desc: Manfred Honeck conducts Yo-Yo Ma and the Berlin Philharmonic in a performance of Schumann's Cello Concerto in A minor, Op. 129 from the Festspielhaus in Baden-Baden 2016.

programme.title: Misha Fomin at the Concertgebouw 2018
programme.desc: Musical critics from North America, Europe, and Russia praise Nalchik-born pianist Misha Fomin for his subtlety of touch and phrasing. He graduated cum laude from the Gnessin’s Russian Academy of Music, Moscow, where he studied with Lina Bulatova, a former student of professor Helen Gnessina and legendary Heinrich Neuhaus, and later continued his musical studies at the Hochschule für Musik “Franz Liszt” in Weimar.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Symphony in Three Movements
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berliner Philharmonic during the 2008 edition of the Europakonzert, held in the renowned hall of the Tchaikovsky Conservatory in Moscow. The first edition of the Europakonzert was in 1991, and since then, the founding of the Berlin Philharmonic on May 1st in 1882 is annually celebrated with a concert in a European city of cultural significance.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Preludes and fugues
programme.desc: Compagnia Simona Bucci presents an extraordinary concert in scenic form: 'Preludi e Fughe - Geografia antropica'. Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87 inspired choreographer Simona Bucci to take on this project. Seven dancers of Compagnia Simona Bucci dance to Shostakovich’s Preludes and Fugues Nos. 1, 5, 7, 12, 13, 14, 16 and 24, played by Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda.

programme.title: Pianomania - Daniil Trifonov
programme.desc: Hannu Lintu conducts the Gulbenkian Orchestra in a Finnish flavoured concert program, since the concert features Cantus Articus, Op. 61 by Einojuhani Rautavaara, and Jean Sibelius’ Symphony No. 2. Furtermore, Daniil Trifonov (1991) is star soloist in Schumann’s Piano Concerto, Op. 54, which was premiered in 1841 by Clara Wieck, wife of the composer.

programme.title: Gala from Berlin - 2010
programme.desc: During the New Year’s Gala 2010, the Berlin Philharmonic perform under the baton of Gustavo Dudamel, whose infectious energy and exceptional artistry have made him one of the most sought-after conductors by orchestras and opera companies around the world. They welcome mezzo-soprano Elina Garanca, who has become one of the world’s most famous singers within just a few years.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna).

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 35
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen conducts Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 in D Major, K. 385, recorded at the Nieuwe Kerk, The Hague, in 2020. Van Alphen founded Sinfonia Rotterdam in 2000. Under his passionate leadership, this orchestra has developed into one of the Netherland’s best-known orchestras. Mozart’s Symphony No. 35 is also known as the “Haffner Symphony”.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s well-known Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. With Sir Simon Rattle's mischievous enthusiasm, this famous heavyweight symphony sounds new again. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Handel - Messiah, HWV 56
programme.desc: Composer George Frideric Handel’s oratorio Messiah, HWV 56 is his best-known work. He wrote this choral masterpiece in just 24 days in 1741. Following its premiere in Dublin in 1742, the work has been immensely popular. The oratorio’s three parts deal with the birth, death, and resurrection of Jesus Christ. Charles Jennens’ libretto is based on texts from the Old and New Testament.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Piano Concerto No. 1
programme.desc: A colourful Christmas concert by the South Netherlands Philharmonic with Tchaikovsky’s famous First Piano Concerto. Chief conductor Dmitry Liss showcases, together with master pianist Boris Berezovsky, a true, Russian spirit. In such a way as to evoke what an American critic had said about one of his previous Tchaikovsky interpretations: “Liss expressed an absolute authority over the orchestra and the audience.

programme.title: Bizet - Carmen
programme.desc: The wild and breathtaking scenery of Austria's Roman Quarry of St. Margarethen provides an ideal and unique backdrop for this live and colourful open-air performance of Georges Bizet's opera Carmen (1875). With over 400 participants, this opulent staging of Bizet's famous opera - one of the most popular works in the genre's history - proves a feast for all the senses. Austria's Opera Festival St.

programme.title: A Mozart Celebration from Berlin
programme.desc: Performed in the grandeur of Berlin's foremost opera house, the Staatsoper Unter den Linden, the Mozart Celebration is dedicated to the life's work of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart. This one-time-only gala concert features exuberant Mozart pieces, performed by some of the world’s leading singers and musicians. Conductor Julien Salemkour leads these beautiful performances played by the Staatskapelle Berlin.

programme.title: Modena - The Belcanto School
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Brahms - Double Concerto in A minor, Op. 102
programme.desc: The 2007 Europa-Konzert takes place in Berlin, on the occasion of the 125th anniversary of the Berliner Philharmoniker.

programme.title: CNN Newsroom Sunday
programme.desc: The latest news and information from around the world.

programme.title: The Whole Story with Anderson Cooper
programme.desc: Anderson Cooper hosts a deeply reported series that goes behind the headlines and into the heart of the most important stories of our time.

programme.title: O Princípio Da Incerteza
programme.desc: Um programa de resumo semanal dos principais temas da atualidade, de natureza política, social e económica. Conduzido por Carlos Andrade.

programme.title: CNN Meia Noite
programme.desc: Fecha-se um ciclo noticioso e abre-se outro. Recordamos os temas que marcaram as últimas hora e ganhamos balanço para um novo dia, espreitando as capas dos jornais e os destaques da imprensa nacional e internacional.

programme.title: CNN M2 - Metro Quadrado
programme.desc: Um programa dedicado ao estado da arte no setor imobiliário em Portugal. Aqui, vamos ficamos a conhecer a realidade deste mercado, num tom aspiracional, mas realista, dirigido a todas famílias mas também aos agentes do setor. Ajudamos a conseguir bons negócios para a compra ou arrendamento, além de úteis conselhos para viver a sua casa! Mas não ficamos por aqui.

programme.title: GTI Plus
programme.desc: GTi é um programa semanal de informação e entretenimento, essencialmente dedicado aos automóveis e à sua utilização nos diversos contextos - quotidiano, profissional, em viagem, competição.

programme.title: Amanpour
programme.desc: O programa Amanpour é um programa sobre assuntos globais apresentado por Christiane Amanpour, jornalista da CNN, que apresenta entrevistas aprofundadas com líderes globais, influenciadores culturais e personalidades de destaque sobre questões críticas globais e nacionais.

programme.title: Pitch
programme.desc: No Pitch mostramos o mundo por detrás das marcas! As marcas desempenham um papel central na forma como vivemos em sociedade. Estão em todo o lado. Nos nossos ecrãs, casas, escritórios, na rua e a sua gestão nunca foi tão complexa! Neste programa vamos revelar os rostos que estão por detrás da gestão diária de marcas globais.

programme.title: O Admirável Mundo Com Richard Quest
programme.desc: O programa de viagens de Richard Quest pode, segundo o próprio, ser resumido numa frase: “vamos a lugares interessantes para conhecer pessoas fascinantes”. Quest viaja de cidade em cidade, procurando compreender o que move cada uma e as pessoas que nela vivem. programme.title: O Poder Da Palavra - 1ª Exibição

Na leitura da Palavra de Deus temos a oportunidade de sermos curados e restaurados. Na Palavra, Deus fala connosco e nos comunica Sua Sabedoria.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 79
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 41
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 26
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 48
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 27
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 84
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 46
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Portrait of Maria Ana Bobone
programme.desc: Maria Ana Bobone (Portugal) is one of the best fado singers of her generation. She started singing fado when she was 16. Her debut album is called ‘Alma Nova’ and marked the beginning of her amazing career. For the recordings of her next two albums, ‘Luz Destino’ and ‘Senhora da Lapa’ Maria Ana welcomed instruments that are usually not present in fado music: the harpsichord and saxophone.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Session: From Rossini to Piazzolla
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music.

programme.title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: Michel Tasky live in Rio: Um Malandro em Paris
programme.desc: With his relaxed and clear voice, Belgian-born vocalist Michel Tasky took his French-Waalse roots to Brazil, where he established himself in the jazz scene. His contemporary style, which blends jazz and French chanson with a whole lot of samba, transports audiences to faraway places.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: West Coast All Stars
programme.desc: This live recording is celebrating 50 years of West Coast Jazz. The West Coast Jazz movement had its origins about 50 years ago in Los Angeles. It was essentially a 'cool' form of jazz played mostly by studio musicians as a break from their studio work. The West Coast All Stars are specially brought together for this West Coast Night.

programme.title: Count Basie and his Orchestra live in Charleroi
programme.desc: Count Basie is one of the most important bandleaders of the swing era. With the exception of a brief period in the early '50s, he led a big band from 1935 until his death almost 50 years later. Basie's orchestra was characterized by a light, swinging rhythm section that he led from the piano, lively ensemble work, and generous soloing. Basie was not a composer like Duke Ellington or an important soloist like Benny Goodman.

programme.title: Rita Reys And The Pim Jacobs Trio at North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Nick Mulvey
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Scott DuBois Quartet Live In Munich
programme.desc: Rising star of the jazz guitar Scott DuBois leads his quartet, consisting of Gebhard Ullmann (reeds), Thomas Morgan (bass), and Kresten Osgood (drums), in an intimate and atmospheric performance at Munich’s Jazz Club Unterfahrt in March 2016. The group’s telepathy is such that they are able to go from deathly quiet to fiercely avant-garde at the drop of a hat.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024 interview - Julia Kadel
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. These portraits were recorded at jazzahead! 2024 in Bremen, Germany.

programme.title: Tim Kliphuis and the NCO: The Changing Seasons
programme.desc: The Netherlands Chamber Orchestra commissioned violinist Tim Kliphuis, internationally known for his genre-crossing approach to music, to write a new version of Antonio Vivaldi's ‘Four Seasons’. Kliphuis choose to take improvisation as his starting point; at the same time, he intended to leave the best-known Vivaldi themes and chords in, as they give the piece its wonderful energy.

programme.title: Salif Keita And Les Ambassadeurs
programme.desc: Salif Keita’s music is a rich combination of traditional Malian music with European and American influences. We can hear this in the instrumentation of Keita’s music, which varies from traditional West-African instruments to Western European ones. The Malian singer was cast out by his family because of his albinism. In 1967 he moved to Bamako, where he started his musical career and joined Les Ambassadeurs (Internationaux).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres.

programme.title: Tania Maria Trio - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Oum - Music Meeting Festival 2018
programme.desc: Oum El Ghait Benessahraoui, who is better known as Oum, gives a unique glance at ethnic Morrocan musical esthetics. The singer-songwriter is considered to be the ambassador of Morrocan culture, too. Deeply influenced by gospel, jazz, soul and RAndB genres, today Oum mixes more and more African music genres, such as Sufi, Hassani, or Afrobeat.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel meets Peter Beets Trio
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: The Hammond© Sessions: Dede Priest
programme.desc: The Dutch Hammond organ player Rob Mostert develops, in cooperation with Stingray DJAZZ, the program Mostert Meets. In this series, the Hammond B3 organ takes center stage. Rob Mostert invites the world’s finest jazz musicians for a musical collaboration, in which the Hammond Organ plays a major role.

programme.title: Duke Ellington Orchestra - Het Concertgebouw
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: TorTube: Dual City Concert Band ft. Hermine Deurlo
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: Basin Street Blues
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: Chick Corea Elektric Band - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Lindyhop.lt, Vilnius, Lithuania
programme.desc: Lithuanian band Olivia Gongas gave an intimate performance at Vilnius jazz dance club Lindyhop.lt in late June 2021. The band, fronted by multi-instrumentalist Remis Rancys, consists of guitarist Laimonas Jancas, bassist Paulius Adomenas, and drummer Domantas Razmus. Olivia Gongas draw from the band’s indie and world music inspirations for this mellow and cosy concert. The Lindyhop.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Trio Chemirani: Dawâr
programme.desc: The veritable tombak virtuosos of Trio Chemirani, consisting of Chemirani Senior and Juniors, enrapture the Festival de Saintes. The tombak is a Persian percussion instrument, but its rhythms are universal. The Trio Chemirani’s music is accessible to all and will certainly resound with each listener. The members of the trio, Djamchid Chemirani (born in Teheran in 1942) and his two sons and pupils Keyvan and Bijan, are living in France.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Anita Oday Live in Sweden 1963
programme.desc: Anita O’Day?boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O’Day’s horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Live at The Metro Theatre
programme.desc: Angus And Julia Stone are an Australian brother-sister folk-blues group which formed in 2006. Their parents played as a folk duo before Julia and Angus were born. Angus And Julia Stone have released two studio albums, A Book Like This (8 September 2007), which peaked at No. 6 on the ARIA Albums Chart; and Down. Here they perform at The Metro Theatre, in Sydney, Australia, on October 10, 2007.

programme.title: Michelle David - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho's Mood
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: Brazilian Stomp
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: The Tällberg Foundation: 'Jazz for the Planet'
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano).

programme.title: Georgie Fame And the Blue Flames
programme.desc: Georgie Fame, known for 'Yeh, Yeh' and 'The Ballad of Bonnie and Clyde' makes a triumphant comeback with The Blue Flames. Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames was a popular band in the UK in the '60s, celebrated for its RAndB, soul, jazz, ska, and pop sounds. The training was largely inspired by ska, a popular musical style in Jamaican cafes in London at the time.

programme.title: Portrait of Roy Ayers
programme.desc: ‘The legend of the groove’ is a series of documentaries devoted to the musicians who were most influential on contemporary hip hop, soul, rhythm 'n' blues, and on the course of history. Between the late 1950s and now, these musicians radically changed music. Although sometimes hardly in the public eye, they have all been major sources of inspiration for today's major artists: Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks and Co: Estival 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence.

programme.title: Seun Kuti And Egypt 80 - Cabaret Sauvage
programme.desc: Seun Anikulapo Kuti possesses the grace, energy and fury of his father, the legendary artist Fela Kuti. With the musicians of Fela Kuti’s legendary band Egypt 80, Seaun Kuti brings the most original incarnation of Afrobeat to life. Digging deep into different African traditions, Seun has brought his own touch to the music by reflecting the difficulties and cultures of the continent.

programme.title: Runtown - La Machine de Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Enjoy Runtown’s first concert in Paris, where the Nigerian superstar brings many guests to his show. One of the most talented Nigerian afrobeat scenes will make you rediscover his greatest hits. Nigeria is a very creative country when it comes to the music scene. Runtown is no exception. His first single, “Party Like It’s 1980,” paved the way for “Gallardo,” which caught the entire international scene's attention.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Benjamin Herman - Dutch Jazz
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: The Wall Will Fall
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: If Only
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound.

programme.title: Duke Ellington: Jazz from Newport, Brussels, 1973
programme.desc: In 1956, Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed a legendary set at the third annual Newport Jazz Festival. It was tenor saxophonist Paul Gonsalves’ outstanding 27-chorus solo on “Diminuendo and Crescendo in Blue” that revitalized Ellington’s career. The success generated during that performance carried him for the rest of his life. By 1973, festivals carrying the Newport name were organized all over the world.

programme.title: Jong Metropole live at Radio Kootwijk
programme.desc: Jong Metropole (Young Metropole) is a unique collaboration between the Dutch Metropole Orchestra, the National Youth Orchestra of the Netherlands and the National Jazz Youth Orchestra of the Netherlands. It aims to prepare talented, young musicians in classical and light music for a professional career.

programme.title: November Music: Jon Balke Siwan
programme.desc: Since 1993, the November Music Festival has been held every year at various locations in the Dutch city of 's-Hertogenbosch. Highlighting a variety of contemporary musical styles and contemporary composers, November Music is today one of the most important festivals dedicated to contemporary music in the Netherlands.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Swing Dealers
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result?

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Yuri Honing
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: The Morgenland Festival: VIVA!
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects. “Viva” is a perfect mixture of various instruments and musicians from all over the world.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Wynton in the South Bank Show
programme.desc: Considered one of the most technically brilliant players in the history of the trumpet, jazz musician Wynton Marsalis is also a master of classical music and a fine composer. Marsalis takes the cameras with him around New York, to his home town of New Orleans, and to his rehearsal studios where he and his assembled band of musicians are seen putting together the album Blood on the Fields.

programme.title: Jungle By Night - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned bands. In 2019, one of them is the Amsterdam-based Dutch instrumental collective Jungle by Night. The band plays a mix of various styles, inspired by funk, jazz, dub, rock, and others. The ensemble made its debut in 2010 and has played at numerous festivals.

programme.title: Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Vishten - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. The 2018 edition of WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Tamara Murphy - Spirograph Studies
programme.desc: Spirograph Studies have leapt onto the Australian music scene with their detailed, textural approach to playing improvised music. Post-rock, post-jazz and post-minimalism, they shamelessly steal sonic palettes from all areas to build their cinematic sound. This collaborative group features Luke Howard (piano), Fran Swinn (guitar) and James McLean (drums).

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Paradox Live: Rolf Delfos
programme.desc: Innovative contemporary jazz and improvised music, the search for modernity, mind blowing sounds, rock and pop… Indeed PARADOX Tilburg goes beyond jazz, crossing musical boundaries into the unknown soundscapes of electronic music. Indie artists, blues veterans and jazz superstars all pour their hearts and souls at the Paradox.

programme.title: Jazz in Comblain-la-Tour, 1963
programme.desc: In 1963, the small Belgian town of Comblain-la-Tour hosted an exciting line-up of both new and older jazz groups. Opening things up is the British trombonist Charlie Galbraith’s All Star Jazz Band, performing classic Dixieland jazz. Next up is German singer Knut Kiesewetter, who, with backing from the Prague Dixieland Band, sings the blues.

programme.title: Stan Getz Quintet - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Legendary American saxophonist Stan Getz gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague in 1980.

programme.title: Fantástico - Ep. 2752
programme.desc: Programa em forma de revista eletrônica, o Show da Vida mistura jornalismo, denúncia, esporte, humor, dramaturgia, documentário, música e ciência.

programme.title: Altas Horas - Ep. 1271
programme.desc: Serginho Groisman promove, semanalmente, debates sobre temas relevantes com a participação da plateia, artistas e personalidades de diferentes áreas.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 163
programme.desc: Lena fica surpresa quando a bebê se acalma no colo de Gerluce. Paulinho fica atento à conversa de Raul com Herculano, e percebe que o executivo esconde algo. Joélly nota que Lena mentiu para ela. Arminda e Ferette ficam sabendo por Zezé que a obra Três Graças será devolvida para seu verdadeiro dono. Gerluce fica preocupada ao saber que Joélly e Raul foram se encontrar com Lena.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 164
programme.desc: Raul e Joélly desconfiam de Lena, que se sente acuada e deixa o local. Joaquim tenta acalmar Arminda e lhe mostra o dinheiro escondido no compartimento da escultura. Kasper e Bagdá denunciam Lucélia. Josefa e Gisleyne desmaiam ao ver uma mão humana enterrada no jardim da casa. Paulinho e Juquinha tentam tirar a verdade de Helga sobre a morte de Célio. Arminda descobre que Ferette é pai de Raul.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 165
programme.desc: Ferette confirma a Arminda que é pai de Raul. Viviane aceita o pedido de casamento de Leonardo. Arminda pensa em tirar a vida de Samira. Helga segue impassível e sustenta que matou Célio sozinha. Arminda recebe uma ligação de Paulinho, convocando-a para uma acareação oficial, e Helga tenta impedir a patroa. Arminda conta a Gerluce e a Raul que foi Samira quem matou Jorginho.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 166
programme.desc: Gerluce conta a Paulinho que Arminda disse que Samira matou Jorginho. Paulinho combina com Jairo como fazer Arminda confessar seus crimes. Marise sugere a Ferette uma forma de implicar Paulinho na expropriação das Três Graças. Lucélia conta a Ferette que os filhos do executivo irão se casar. Bagdá é levado para o presídio. Samira aborda Raul.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 167
programme.desc: Samira convence Raul a entrar em seu carro, e ele descobre que Ferette é seu pai. Jairo orienta Paulinho a ficar quieto até o fim da apuração. Juquinha não consegue convencer João Rubens a conversar com Kasper. Gerluce tenta tranquilizar Paulinho. Gerluce e Paulinho ficam preocupados com a demora de Raul para chegar em casa. Ferette confirma para Raul que é seu pai.

programme.title: Três Graças - Ep. 168
programme.desc: Juquinha avisa a Paulinho que estão providenciando a prisão de Lena e Herculano. Ferette garante a Arminda que impedirá a posse de Gerluce. Arminda pensa em sequestrar a bebê de Lena. Joaquim e Lígia se beijam. Herculano e Lena não se dão conta de que estão sendo seguidos.

programme.title: Lady Night - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Marcelo Serrado já fez de tudo em sua carreira, mas nada se compara ao caos divertido e surpreendente de sua participação no Lady Night. Só assistindo para entender o porquê.

programme.title: A Próxima Vítima - Ep. 36
programme.desc: Após o assassinato de Francesca Ferreto, a trama policial traz diversos crimes supostamente sem conexão entre si, mas com pistas comuns deixadas pelo autor.

programme.title: Alma Gêmea - Ep. 66
programme.desc: Felipe planeja um passeio com Serena. Vitório faz uma serenata para Olívia. Dalila se surpreende com Roberval. Rodriguez dá um flagra em Kátia. Cristina arma um plano com Guto.

programme.title: Malhação - Sonhos T22 - Ep. 275
programme.desc: Duca vai para o hospital. Gael se assusta ao entrar na casa de Lobão. Os alunos ocupam a Ribalta como forma de protesto. Gael procura Heidguer.

programme.title: Orgulho E Paixão - Ep. 55
programme.desc: Camilo perde a luta, mas recebe uma proposta para voltar ao lugar. Estilingue descobre que pode ser neto do Barão. Darcy pede perdão a Charlotte. Januário e Ernesto acodem Camilo. Mariana sofre com a decisão de Brandão de se afastar dela. Tenória pede que Jorge a acompanhe ao Vale do Café. Mariana decide investigar as corridas de Brandão. Ernesto beija Ema e Jorge vê os dois.

programme.title: Coração Acelerado - Ep. 144
programme.desc: João Raul percebe o estado alterado de Agrado, e cuida da moça. Tino agradece a noite passada com Esteban. Malvino e Laurinha percebem que passaram a noite lado a lado, e confessam seu amor. Leandro e Eduarda finalmente ficam juntos. Agrado lembra de ter beijado João Raul e se surpreende. Talita elogia o Zuzanete em suas redes, e Ronei e Zilá ficam indignados com o fracasso de seu plano. Eva convida Vânia para sair.

programme.title: Conversa Com Bial - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Uma conversa não é feita apenas de assuntos. Saber falar, ter o que dizer, ouvir e escutar são igualmente importantes para a construção de um diálogo.

programme.title: Rainha da Sucata - Ep. 151
programme.desc: Edu implora que Maria do Carmo volte a trabalhar com ele. Renato se preocupa com a matéria de jornal sobre ele. Gerson decide reconquistar Maria do Carmo. Alaíde não se sente bem.

programme.title: Império - Ep. 114
programme.desc: Danielle confessa que fez gravação comprometedora. Maurílio é o principal suspeito de vazar as informações. Salvador atrapalha esquema de Orville. Cora faz proposta ao Comendador.

programme.title: Passione - Ep. 102
programme.desc: Agostina e Jéssica se encontram e descobrem que ambas são casadas com Berilo.

programme.title: A Nobreza Do Amor - Ep. 46
programme.desc: Dumi garante a Akin, Omar e Ladisa que a princesa Alika não aprovaria a execução de Jendal. Viriato repreende Carrapato por vestir sua batina. Virgínia e sua família aprontam a festa de seu noivado com Mirinho. José consegue mudar a data da inauguração do ateliê de Alika. Omar pede perdão a Dumi por sua atitude impulsiva contra Jendal. Maria Helena pensa em uma forma de fazer a escola acontecer.

programme.title: A Próxima Vítima - Ep. 37
programme.desc: Helena procura Juca e se desculpa pelo filho. Todos se preocupam com o sumiço de Josias. Diva entrega a Ana o envelope com as fotos comprometedoras de Andréia.
